name: Microsoft UFO
description: Automates Windows desktop apps through natural-language tasks with the UFO2 Desktop AgentOS, and orchestrates agents across Windows, Linux, and Android devices with UFO3 Galaxy.

skills.name: Windows Desktop Automation
skills.description: Completes multi-app Windows tasks from a natural-language request using a HostAgent and AppAgents, launched with python -m ufo.

skills.name: Hybrid GUI Actions
skills.description: Combines GUI clicks with native API calls through Windows UIA, Win32, and WinCOM, using visual plus UIA detection to find controls.

skills.name: Speculative Multi-Action
skills.description: Batches predicted actions into a single step to cut the number of LLM calls needed to finish a desktop automation task.

skills.name: Galaxy Orchestration
skills.description: Decomposes a request into a task DAG and assigns steps to Windows, Linux, and Android device agents that run in parallel.
